params.prompt:
A production PIXEL ART game animation sheet of ONE cheerful red cartoon Sproto monster. Exact face from the attached head portrait: round wide RED head, two huge round YELLOW eyes with black pupils and white glints, broad wide RED smiling muzzle with two nostril dots, swept RED spiky forelock, round ears and BLUE chin band. The complete character wears a fully opaque high-neck RED athletic jacket with long sleeves, visible collar and cuffs, matching RED full-length trousers and RED sneakers. Maintain the same outfit and proportions in every drawing. A modest athletic cartoon design, head almost shoulder width, two normal red fingered hands, two connected low-rooted legs. Each cell one complete body facing RIGHT. Crisp stepped pixels, compact limited-color shading, dark outlines, generous empty margins. Flat pure WHITE #ffffff background everywhere, no shadows, grid lines, labels, effects or other subjects.
Exactly 32 drawings in EIGHT rows and FOUR columns. Strict equal-cell layout, FOUR drawings in every row.
Row 1: friendly head tilt, jaunty open hand flourish, planted pivot, combat guard.
Row 2: crouching anticipation, shoulder windup, forward straight punch, retract.
Row 3: alternate shoulder strike, recoil to guard, planted two-hand push, recover.
Row 4: inhale head leans back hands at ribs, puff cheeks with pursed lips, head snaps RIGHT with open mouth to spit, relaxed mouth returns to smile. No projectile drawn.
Row 5: playful surprised chest lean, head leans back, knees absorb, regain guard.
Row 6: silly cartoon stumble, knees fold, red-sleeved hands brace descent, gently roll onto side.
Row 7: complete dressed character entirely side-lying with head LEFT and feet RIGHT, relaxed side-lying settle, small shoulder drop, completely still resting pose.
Row 8: same complete dressed side-lying rest with tiny hand change, same rest, same rest, final relaxed rest. Keep face recognizable, blue chin and red suit visible in all floor drawings. Do not stand up in the final eight drawings.
